C2: Project plan. Gantt chart, task descriptions, contingencies, information sources, fits mission narrative. Accomplished, 9.

R2: partial/yes — plan relates to space segment (orbit, launch, ground control); orbit work planned. The plan applies course material (launch, orbits). Yes.

Fine. Weekly coverage issue acknowledged. Maybe note that 10 m resolution at 600 km is challenging but that's design work later.

Overall: strong submission.
